tools.name: honest-price-checker
tools.description: Deal-checking agents already have fetches, but they fail on the judgment: a stale in-stock flag, the wrong variant, or an inflated was-price dressed up as a sale. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Scores caller-supplied price observations only (no retailer scrape): baseline min/median/max, whet

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "honest-price-checker" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: item_key, listed_now, listed_was, history, claimed_variant, observed_variant
